on Map 5-H in the area bounded by: '

A line 484 feet southeast of the intersection of North Western Avenue and North
Milwaukee Avenue as measured along the northeast right-of-way line of North
Milwaukee Avenue and perpendicular thereto; the alley northeast of and parallel to

                                         NARRATIVE A N D PLANS
                            FOR T H E PROPOSED ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
                              AT 1887-1891 N O R T H M I L W A U K E E A V E N U E

        The Application on behalf of the current property Owner, Tyrconncll, LLC, is applying for a
Zoning Map Amendment to B3-3 Community Shopping District for purposes of constructing a
mixed-use building with fifteen (15) dwellingunits (ten 2-bedroom and five 1-bedroom units); the
Buildingwill be four (4) stories in height with one (1) ground floor Retail space of 5,480 square feet
with 4,419 square feet daycare facility. The Application is filed under 17-13-0302-A as a Type 1 filing.
The footprint of the building shall be approximately 66 feet wide by 82 feet deep. The building heij^t
shall be 46 feet, 7 inches, as defined by City Code.

SPECIFIC CRITERLA FOR THIS EQUITABLE TRANSIT SERVED L O C A T I O N

         Under Section 17-03-0308 any new construction or rehabilitation or reuse of existing
structures within 2,640 feet of a CTA or METRA rail station entrance must satisfy aU of the following
criteria (the proposed is a fifteen (15) dwelling unit mixed use, new construction Building with two (2)
off-street parking (Garage) parking spaces:-

        1. The Pro)ect complies with Section 17-10-0102-B, located 490 feet southeast of the CTA
           Blue Line station at Westem Avenue as well as the CTA #56 Bus line;
        2. The site is not a Pedestrian Street under 17-3-0504; (non-accessory parking abutting a
           Pedestrian Street is not applicable);
        3. The Project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development
           Guide since it is located in a Local Activity Center Area as an in-fill development and both
           on a qualified CTA Bus route (#56) and in close proximity to the Blue Line;
        4. The mixed-use Project requires zero (0) off-street parking spaces although two (2)
           handicapped spaces are provided;
        5. The Project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan mles of the
           Chicago Department of Transportation.
